result.summary: The page mostly looks intact, but two layout areas appear cut off: content near the bottom is hidden behind the fixed navigation bar, and the horizontal restaurant row on the right edge is clipped.

issues.description: The second card in the "Popular right now" section is partially hidden behind the bottom navigation bar, making the content look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so cards can fully clear the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The rightmost card in the "Fastest near you" row is clipped at the edge of the screen, which makes the carousel look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Increase side padding or make the horizontal scrolling area more clearly reveal that more content is available off-screen.
